page_index=0
all_notes=[]
while True:
    resp = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=sn_access_token, query='Friends Dinner', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    items = resp
    if not items:
        break
    all_notes.extend(items)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>20:
        break

print('friends_dinner_note_count', len(all_notes))
# sort by updated_at desc
all_notes_sorted = sorted(all_notes, key=lambda x: x.get('updated_at',''), reverse=True)
for n in all_notes_sorted:
    print(n['note_id'], n['title'], 'created', n['created_at'], 'updated', n['updated_at'], 'pinned', n.get('pinned'), 'tags', n.get('tags'))

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Login phone
pw = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
cred = {x['account_name']: x['password'] for x in pw}
phone_token = apis.phone.login(username='6017026518', password=cred['phone'])['access_token']
print('phone_token_ready', bool(phone_token))

names = ['Adrian','Katie','Martin','Robin','Matthew','Melissa','Glenn','Brenda']

all_contacts=[]
for nm in names:
    page_index=0
    matches=[]
    while True:
        resp = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=nm, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        items = resp
        if not items:
            break
        matches.extend(items)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index>10:
            break
    # print summary
    print('\ncontact_matches_for', nm, 'count', len(matches))
    for c in matches:
        print(' ', c.get('contact_id'), c.get('first_name'), c.get('last_name'), 'email', c.get('email'), 'phone', c.get('phone_number'), 'relationships', c.get('relationships'))
    all_contacts.append((nm, matches))

# date range
cur_date = datetime.strptime(apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()['date'], '%A, %B %d, %Y').date()
yesterday = cur_date - timedelta(days=1)

emails = {
    'Adrian': 'adrian_burt@gmail.com',
    'Katie': 'kat_simp@gmail.com',
    'Melissa': 'mel.bailey@gmail.com',
    'Glenn': 'glenn.burton@gmail.com',
    'Martin': 'mar_blac@gmail.com',

    'Brenda': 'brenda.webe@gmail.com',
}

# Fetch received transactions and check amount matches regardless of description
venmo_access_token = venmo_access_token

def fetch_received(user_email):
    out=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        resp = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
            access_token=venmo_access_token,
            user_email=user_email,
            min_created_at=min_created_at,
            max_created_at=max_created_at,
            direction='received',
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=20
        )
        items = resp
        if not items:
            break
        out.extend(items)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index > 50:
            break
    return out

amount_matches = {}
for name, share in shares.items():
    email = emails[name]
    txns = fetch_received(email)
    matches = []
    for t in txns:
        amt = t.get('amount')
        if amt is None:
            continue
        if abs(float(amt) - float(share)) < 1e-6:
            matches.append(t)
    amount_matches[name] = matches
    print(name, 'received_txn_count', len(txns), 'amount_match_count', len(matches), 'match_txn_ids', [m.get('transaction_id') for m in matches])

print('unpaid_by_amount_only', [n for n,m in amount_matches.items() if len(m)==0])
